title: Judgment Pronounced

questions.question: During the reigns of which kings of Judah did the word of the Lord come to Micah?
questions.explanation: Micah 1:1 (ESV): "The word of the Lord that came to Micah of Moresheth in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah,"

questions.question: What will the Lord make Samaria into?
questions.explanation: Micah 1:6 (ESV): "Therefore I will make Samaria a heap in the open country, a place for planting vineyards,"

questions.question: All her carved images shall be beaten to pieces, and all her wages shall be...
questions.explanation: Micah 1:7 (ESV): "All her carved images shall be beaten to pieces, all her wages shall be burned with fire,"

questions.question: Because of the judgment, Micah says he will lament and wail, going stripped and...
questions.explanation: Micah 1:8 (ESV): "For this I will lament and wail; I will go stripped and naked;"

questions.question: For her wound is incurable, and it has come to...
questions.explanation: Micah 1:9 (ESV): "For her wound is incurable, and it has come to Judah;"

questions.question: Tell it not in Gath; weep not at all; in Beth-leaphrah roll yourselves in the...
questions.explanation: Micah 1:10 (ESV): "Tell it not in Gath; weep not at all; in Beth-leaphrah roll yourselves in the dust."

questions.question: For the inhabitants of Maroth wait anxiously for good, because disaster has come down from the Lord to the...
questions.explanation: Micah 1:12 (ESV): "because disaster has come down from the Lord to the gate of Jerusalem."

questions.question: Make yourself bald and cut off your hair, for the children of your delight; make yourself as bald as the...
questions.explanation: Micah 1:16 (ESV): "make yourself as bald as the eagle, for they shall go from you into exile."

questions.question: Harness the steeds to the chariot, inhabitants of...
questions.explanation: Micah 1:13 (ESV): "Harness the steeds to the chariot, inhabitants of Lachish;"

questions.question: Lachish was the beginning of sin to the daughter of...
questions.explanation: Micah 1:13 (ESV): "it was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion,"

questions.question: Therefore you shall give parting gifts to...
questions.explanation: Micah 1:14 (ESV): "Therefore you shall give parting gifts to Moresheth-gath;"

questions.question: The houses of Achzib shall be a deceitful thing to the kings of...
questions.explanation: Micah 1:14 (ESV): "the houses of Achzib shall be a deceitful thing to the kings of Israel."

questions.question: Look, the Lord is coming out of his place, and will come down and tread upon the...
questions.explanation: Micah 1:3 (ESV): "For behold, the Lord is coming out of his place, and will come down and tread upon the high places of the earth."

questions.question: The mountains will melt under him, and the valleys will split open, like wax before the...
questions.explanation: Micah 1:4 (ESV): "like wax before the fire, like waters poured down a steep place."

questions.question: All this is for the transgression of Jacob and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? Is it not...
questions.explanation: Micah 1:5 (ESV): "What is the transgression of Jacob? Is it not Samaria?"

key_verse_text: Hear, you peoples, all of you; pay attention, O earth, and all that is in it, and let the Lord God be a witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.
